message:
Now I understand the flow. When an exception is raised, `mrb_exc_set` calls `mrb_keep_backtrace` which calls `packed_backtrace` which calls `each_backtrace`. The `each_backtrace` iterates over the call stack and for each frame, computes `idx = pc - irep->iseq`. If `idx >= irep->ilen`, `mrb_debug_get_position` returns FALSE without initializing `loc.lineno` and `loc.filename`.

The key question is: when does `pc` point past the end of the iseq? Let me look at how `pc` is managed in the VM. When an exception is raised, the `pc` in the current callinfo might be at the end of the iseq.

Let me look at how `ci->pc` is set in the VM:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "ci->pc\|cibase\[.*\]\.pc\|->pc" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mruby/src/vm.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
